ACCOUNT.TITLE: Account
ACCOUNT.DESCRIPTION: Sign-in and sync will be available once bibo has a backend.

STATUS.TITLE: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: You are in guest mode. All boards are saved in this browser.

MENU.SIGN_IN_SOON: Coming soon, waiting on the backend
MENU.LOCAL_DESCRIPTION: Not synced to the cloud. Clearing browser data will delete your boards.

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Email and notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Choose when bibo notifies you. Available once bibo has a backend and accounts.

DIGEST.TITLE: Activity digest email
DIGEST.DESCRIPTION: Email a summary of changes on boards you take part in.

MENTION.TITLE: When someone mentions you
MENTION.DESCRIPTION: Notify you when someone mentions you in a note or comment.

INVITE.TITLE: When invited to a board
INVITE.DESCRIPTION: Notify you when someone shares a board with you.

NEWS.TITLE: Product news
NEWS.DESCRIPTION: Occasional emails about new bibo features.

APPEARANCE.TITLE: Appearance
APPEARANCE.DESCRIPTION: Customize how bibo looks. Saved in this browser.

STYLE.TITLE: Style
STYLE.HAND_HINT: Sketchy outlines with a drafted feel.
STYLE.FLAT_HINT: Clean straight outlines that follow the theme tokens.

FONT.TITLE: Font
FONT.DESCRIPTION: Choosing a font for the app. This section opens once decided.

TOOLBAR.TITLE: Toolbar
TOOLBAR.DESCRIPTION: Choose which buttons appear on the canvas toolbar.

CANVAS.TITLE: Canvas
CANVAS.DESCRIPTION: Background grid and scrolling on the canvas. Saved in this browser.

GRID.TITLE: Background grid
GRID.DESCRIPTION: Show dots on the canvas background.

SCROLL_SPEED.TITLE: Scroll speed
SCROLL_SPEED.DESCRIPTION: Distance moved per mouse wheel step. Ctrl + wheel still zooms.

SHORTCUTS.TITLE: Shortcuts
SHORTCUTS.DESCRIPTION: List of available keyboard shortcuts. On Mac, use Cmd instead of Ctrl.

LOCALIZATION.TITLE: Language and region
LOCALIZATION.DESCRIPTION: Interface language and how dates are shown.

DATE_FORMAT.TITLE: Date format
DATE_FORMAT.DESCRIPTION: How dates are shown in the app.

WEEK_START.TITLE: First day of week
WEEK_START.DESCRIPTION: Used for calendars and date pickers.

DATA.TITLE: Data
DATA.DESCRIPTION: Boards, objects and storage in use.

BOARDS.TITLE: Boards
BOARDS.DESCRIPTION: Number of boards, including Home and sub-boards.

OBJECTS.TITLE: Objects
OBJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Total notes, board tiles and other objects, including Unsort.

USAGE.TITLE: Storage
USAGE.DESCRIPTION: Estimated storage bibo uses in this browser.

BACKUP.TITLE: Backup
BACKUP.DESCRIPTION: Download all boards to your device. Available once bibo has a backend and sync.

DELETE_MANY.TITLE: Delete multiple objects?
DELETE_MANY.DESCRIPTION: This deletes {items}. You can undo this (Ctrl+Z).

DELETE_BOARD.TITLE: Delete board "{name}"?
DELETE_BOARD.EMPTY: This board is empty. You can undo this (Ctrl+Z).
DELETE_BOARD.DESCRIPTION: This removes {items}. You can undo this (Ctrl+Z).
